capabilities: Shrink pinned note tabs to icons
Restore Iconize icons after tab-header updates
Ship built-in styles for shrunken pinned tabs
disambiguation: Not a tool for unpinning notes; it only shrinks pinned tabs to their Iconize icons.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later and Iconize's "Toggle icon in tabs" setting enabled; the plugin includes the styles from the separate mini-pinned-tab.css snippet, and release files carry GitHub attestations verifiable with GitHub CLI.
intentEvidence: Shrinks pinned note tabs to the icons assigned to them by Iconize.
problem: Pinned note tabs keep their full titles and can lose their Iconize icons when tab headers update, so they take up tab-bar space and show the wrong icon.

relations.evidence: Shrinks pinned note tabs to the icons assigned to them by Iconize.

summary: Plugin that shrinks pinned note tabs to their Iconize icons and restores an icon when a tab-header update replaces it.
